title: Allow setting custom password/PIN just for the screen locker
line: You can now set a short PIN in System Settings that unlocks the lock screen, while your account password keeps working everywhere.
explanation: The lock screen only ever accepted what PAM accepts, so unlocking always needed the full account password, even for people who only lock to keep a cat or a child off the keyboard. There was no way to set something shorter just for the lock screen. The Screen Locking page now has an "Unlock PIN" row with Set/Change/Remove buttons; the PIN is stored in kscreenlockerrc as a salted PBKDF2-SHA512 hash. The greeter checks a typed answer against that hash before handing it to PAM, so both the PIN and the password unlock, and after five wrong answers in one lock only the password works.

commits.message:
kcm, greeter: add a separate PIN for unlocking the screen

Unlocking the screen always needed the full account password. Users can
now set a PIN in the Screen Locking settings, stored as a salted hash,
which the greeter accepts in place of the password for five attempts.

BUG: 411698
